sources.show_ball: Whether the Results Playback panel starts with the decorative ball at address (the native export's ball: placed at the address face, hidden from the contact instant).
sources.show_flight: Whether the panel starts with the ball flight trace. Off by default so the view opens uncluttered. The ball placement and flight are computed on a background thread either way, because the ball sits where the shot's face strikes it; solving the straight club roll takes several flight-model evaluations (seconds on a full swing).
sources.show_aim_line: Whether the panel starts with the finish aim line (ball to where the ball finishes, aim_line_settings.json of the export).
sources.shot_shape: Shot shape the panel starts with: one of the export presets straight, draw or fade (shot_setup_settings.json); names are the ball curve of a right-handed golfer.
sources.default_club: Club name given to the flight model (validity envelope and roll-out class) when the specification names no club.
sources.poll_interval_ms: How often (milliseconds) the panel checks whether the background ball and flight computation has finished.
sources.flight_unavailable_tooltip: Tooltip of the disabled Ball flight and Aim line check boxes; {reason} says why the flight model cannot run (for example the upstream_physics Rust flight wheel is missing or older than the physics revision the flight model requires).
